review_candidates.title: Senior Java Spring boot developer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The person in this role will design, develop, and maintain backend services and microservices using Java and the Spring ecosystem. Daily responsibilities include implementing robust APIs, optimizing application performance, troubleshooting and resolving technical issues, and ensuring code quality through testing and code reviews. The Senior Developer will collaborate with architects, developers, QA, and DevOps teams to deliver secure, scalable solutions aligned with client requirements. Qualific
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The Senior Developer will collaborate with architects, developers, QA, and DevOps teams to deliver secure, scalable solutions aligned with client requirements. Qualifications 5+ Years of experience Strong Software Development skills, including designing, implementing, and maintaining enterprise-grade applications. Hands-on experience with Java and solid Programming fundamentals (object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms). Expertise in the Spring Framework and Spring Boot, including building RESTful services and integrating with external systems. Proficiency with modern development practices (Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code reviews).
